meetingDocuments.description: Christopher Mufarrige, of Texas, to be a Federal Trade Commissioner for the term of seven years from September 26, 2026, vice Alvaro M. Bedoya, term expired.
Loren Smith, Jr., of Virginia, to be an Assistant Secretary of Transportation, vice Christopher A. Coes, resigned.
Peter A. Feldman, of the District of Columbia, to be a Commissioner of the Consumer Product Safety Commission for a term of seven years from October 27, 2026. (Reappointment)

committeeMeeting.title: Hearings to examine the nominations of Peter A. Feldman, of the District of Columbia, to be a Commissioner of the Consumer Product Safety Commission, Christopher Mufarrige, of Texas, to be a Federal Trade Commissioner, and Loren Smith, Jr., of Virginia, to be an Assistant Secretary of Transportation.
